q: the verse of the throne, Allah the ever-living the sustainer
there is no compulsion in religion
Allah does not burden a soul beyond what it can bear
seek help through patience and prayer
by time, indeed mankind is in loss
say He is Allah the One, the eternal refuge
Allah is the light of the heavens and the earth
in the remembrance of Allah do hearts find rest
we made you peoples and tribes that you may know one another
whoever saves one life it is as if he saved all of mankind
do not despair of the mercy of Allah
call upon Me and I will respond to you
guide us to the straight path
those who spend their wealth in charity night and day
and He found you lost and guided you
the night of decree is better than a thousand months
